name: Omfurn India
why: Promoters raised their stake by 1.5 pts in a year
Big order wins: about Rs 39 Cr announced in 6 months = 38% of annual sales
risks: Not at record: quarterly sales, quarterly profit
Margins shrinking (15% to 14%) - record profit may be near peak
Working capital stretching - debtor days 140 to 171, inventory days 215 to 387 (rising): check receivables / stock build-up
Credit rating BBB-/Stable (CRISIL) - weaker credit quality
Latest quarter Sep 2026: Weak (sales +23% YoY, profit +0% YoY)
FIIs (foreign funds) cut holding by 1.7 pts in a year
Shareholder count up 34% in a year - retail crowding in
Cost quality weak: margin shrinking or operating profit falling (costs 85% to 86% of sales)
Micro cap (Rs 53 Cr): thin trading, higher risk - keep the position small
Weak cash conversion: operating cash flow only 12% of 3-year profit
Sector cycle: Weak / out of favour
